report: attempt-005 independent analysis: __DATA_CONST write permission fault after arm_vm_init
verdict: CONFIRMED_BY_INFERENCE: kc-tools inflates the embedded kernel __TEXT vmsize over __DATA_CONST; arm_vm_prot_init then leaves a mixed 2 MiB contiguous-hint group (hinted RO __TEXT plus unhinted RW __DATA_CONST) whenever the m1n1-chosen slide puts a full 2 MiB window inside the inflated __TEXT range.

evidence_limits.hardware_pte_dump: NOT AVAILABLE. No page-table bytes from TTBR1 were read. The RO-TLB explanation is inference from source, KC bytes and captured registers.
evidence_limits.tlb_behaviour: A misprogrammed contiguous bit is architecturally CONSTRAINED UNPREDICTABLE. An RO 2 MiB TLB entry is consistent with the observed L3 permission fault, but which outcome the core chose was not observed.

xnu_source.tree: sources/puredarwin-m1-bringup (HEAD e7aa00a60f0b56ef35aa24252e81467787bf71ea plus staged bringup changes)

osfmk/arm64/arm_vm_init.c.state: staged-modified (AuxKC sentinel only; the inspected hint/prot logic is upstream text)

register_decode.ESR_EL12: 0x9600004f: EC 0x25 data abort same EL, WnR=1, DFSC 0x0f permission fault level 3, S1PTW=0
register_decode.FAR_EL12: 0xfffffe001391c9b8 = linked 0xfffffe000718c9b8 + 0xc790000; _startup_phase is local symbol 's' at that linked address in kernel.debug.t8103 (DATA_CONST+0xc9b8)

slide_source.code: captured proxyclient hv/__init__.py:1726-1734,1794-1795: phys_base = heap_top; guest_base = phys_base + 16MiB + align(ADT) + align(TC); tba.virt_base = 0xfffffe0010000000 + (phys_base & (32MiB-1))
slide_source.consequence: VA == PA mod 32 MiB in both, but each segment's 2 MiB phase changes with heap_top

builder_lines.src/fileset.c:1008-1010: embedded kernel __TEXT.vmsize = text_exec_vmaddr - __TEXT.vmaddr when larger (applies to ARM64 and RISCV64; no rationale comment) => __TEXT covers __DATA_CONST and __LASTDATA_CONST

xnu_mechanism.hint_width: proc_reg.h __ARM_16K_PG__: ARM_PTE_HINT_ENTRIES 128, ARM_PTE_HINT_ADDR_SHIFT 21 => 2 MiB contiguous group (architectural L3 contiguous span for 16K granule)
xnu_mechanism.helper_rule: arm_vm_page_granular_helper sets ARM_PTE_HINT on a page only if va >= roundup2M(start) and roundup2M(va+1) <= end and ALLOW_HINT. Later requests rewrite only their own PTEs and never clear hints on neighbours. The kva_active asserts guarding hint changes are inert before table activation.
xnu_mechanism.prot_init_order: segSizeTEXT from getsegdatafromheader(__TEXT) vmsize (arm_vm_init.c:2026); __TEXT RNX with BLOCK|HINT (1465), then __DATA_CONST RWNX with BLOCK only
xnu_mechanism.attempt005_group: TEXT request [0xfffffe0013794000,0xfffffe0013ac4000) fully contains [0xfffffe0013800000,0xfffffe0013a00000): 68 hinted RO __TEXT PTEs plus 60 unhinted RW __DATA_CONST PTEs (0xfffffe0013910000-0xfffffe00139fc000)
xnu_mechanism.attempt004: TEXT request [0xfffffe0012e30000,0xfffffe0013160000) contains no full 2 MiB window => no hinted PTEs => no conflict
xnu_mechanism.missed_guard: assert(segDATACONSTB == segTEXTB + segSizeTEXT) at arm_vm_init.c:2267 would reject the inflated size but runs only for non-fileset kernels

offline_model.method: Replays all arm_vm_prot_init requests (KC header, PRELINK_TEXT, gap, __TEXT, __DATA_CONST, __TEXT_EXEC, __DATA, __HIBDATA, __BOOTDATA, __KLD, __KLDDATA, __LASTDATA_CONST, __PRELINK_INFO) at 16 KiB page granularity, using the KC's linked addresses and sizes, the helper's hint rule and last-writer-wins PTE semantics. A 2 MiB group is flagged when it contains any hinted PTE and mixed (perm, hint) values.

results.attempt005_slide_0xc790000: exactly one: group 0xfffffe0013800000, hinted {R} vs 60 unhinted RW __DATA_CONST PTEs

all_phases.definition: phys_base mod 32 MiB in 16 KiB steps; slide = phase + 0x10b8000 + 0xa000000

offline_model.other_checks: Stack guards (_intstack_low_guard 0xfffffe0008608000, _intstack_high_guard 0xfffffe0008610000, _excepstack_high_guard 0xfffffe0008618000 linked) lie in __BOOTDATA, mapped without hint: unaffected. __DATA_CONST/__LASTDATA_CONST overlap: both RWNX in prot_init and RNX in finalize, neither hinted: benign for permissions.

builder_requirement_assessment.arm64: No XNU arm64 consumer needs __TEXT to reach __TEXT_EXEC. segSizeTEXT is used for the __TEXT RNX mapping, etext, kernel_text_contains (which checks __DATA_CONST separately) and the non-fileset assert. Upstream semantics are the linker's __TEXT extent.
builder_requirement_assessment.riscv64: riscv_vm_init.c:410 derives segHIGHESTRO from segTEXTB+segSizeTEXT only when segHIGHESTROKC is 0; a riscv-only retention is plausible but was not analysed here
builder_requirement_assessment.recommended_fix: emit the linker's own __TEXT extent (0x17c000 here) on arm64; do not disable contiguous hints or protections
builder_requirement_assessment.kernel_side_alternative: fileset-only clamp segSizeTEXT = segDATACONSTB - segTEXTB when overlapping (kernel owner's decision)
